TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- 首页改版：统计白卡、连续天数和热力图；「分享」官网和 GitHub。
- 「设置位置」只显示没设置好的项。
- 提示音改为柔和的「登登」。
- 提示音改为钝化的「嘟嘟」：开始上扬，结束下降。
- 拼出的大写字母也会对照上下文核对，识别错了会改正。
- 需求助手改名「提示词模式」，先问能读哪些资料、能否联网，以及创新还是重复。
- 三个人、两天这类小数目保留汉字；金额、日期、百分比等仍用阿拉伯数字。
- 提示音更柔和，录音条更窄。
- 新手引导每步可跳过；练习说对即通过，改用录音条操作。
- 修复 Mac 1.24.0 打开即退出。1.24.0 无法打开时，请从官网重新下载安装。
- 新图标：白底黑条。
- 新录音条：灰底 ✕ 取消、白底 ✓ 完成。取消后 6 秒内可撤销。
- 设置只剩听写、模型、通用三页；少用的放进「高级」。
- 精简：去掉解释触发词、表达示例、风格插件、插件市场和多余开关。
- 词典回到一张表；粘贴后你改过的词自动加入。
- 听写不再弹窗；可能有误时照常插入并提示。
- 修复「1.5万元」「2 万元」等数字被改错。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- New Home: stat tiles, streaks and a heatmap; Share for the website and GitHub.
- The setup card lists only what is not set up yet.
- Softer two-note cues with a natural fade.
- Softer two-note cues: rising when recording starts, falling when it stops.
- Spelled capitals and acronyms are checked against the context and corrected when it clearly points elsewhere.
- The requirements assistant is now Prompt mode. It first asks what the AI may read or search, and whether the work is creative or routine.
- Small counts in Chinese (三个人, 两天) stay in characters; money, dates and percentages still use digits.
- A softer start sound and a narrower recording bar.
- Setup can be skipped at any step; the practice passes once it hears you and uses the recording bar.
- Fixed Mac 1.24.0 quitting at launch. If 1.24.0 does not open, download and install again from the site.
- New icon: black bars on white.
- New recording bar: grey ✕ to cancel, white ✓ to finish. Undo a cancel within 6 seconds.
- Settings are now three tabs: Dictation, Models, General, with rarely used items under Advanced.
- Simpler: context markers, wording examples, style plugins, the plugin market and extra switches are gone.
- The dictionary is one list again; words you fix after a paste are added.
- No more confirmation popups; uncertain results are inserted with a note.
- Fixed numbers such as 1.5万元 and 2 万元 being rewritten wrongly.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

|---|---|

| Windows 10 1809 以上 / Windows 11，64 位 | `TypeLeast-1.24.5-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` 或 `TypeLeast-1.24.5-Windows-x64-Portable.zip` |
